retrievalProfile.description: A centered, high-contrast studio photograph of a natural bird's nest containing a single white egg marked with a graphic symbol, set against a textured, neutral-toned background with top-aligned sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, top-down perspective of a dark, intricately woven twig nest resting on a light beige, fibrous paper surface. Inside the nest sits a smooth white egg featuring a soft-edged pink question mark. The lighting is directional, creating a soft shadow to the right. Typography is clustered at the top edge in a bold, rounded sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark, chaotic texture of the nest contrasts with the smooth, geometric oval of the egg.
The pink graphic on the egg acts as the primary focal point within the secondary focal point of the nest.
Top-aligned text creates a horizontal header that balances the central circular subject.
The neutral background texture unifies the organic subject with the graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Single egg centered in a twig nest

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The nest and egg are centrally located, occupying approximately 50% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white egg with the pink question mark serves as the high-contrast anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central egg, move outward to the nest's texture, then upward to the text headers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the textured background surrounding the central nest.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white egg and dark nest.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones with one warm accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric, rounded sans-serif with thick strokes
letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in varying weights and sizes for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Question mark symbol applied to the surface of the egg
Circular logo in top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, geometric 70s soul aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary rounded terminals and uniform weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photograph of a dark brown twig bird nest centered on a beige textured paper background. Place a single, smooth white egg in the center of the nest. Use soft studio lighting from the top-left to cast a gentle shadow to the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a bold rounded sans-serif like Bauhaus, add lowercase text at the top of the frame in a muted red color. Apply a matching pink question mark graphic onto the surface of the egg, following its curvature.

verificationChecks: Is the text lowercase and tightly tracked?
Is the background texture visible and organic?
Is the question mark correctly warped to the egg's surface?
Is the nest centered with sufficient negative space?

adjustableVariables: Specific wording of the top-aligned text
mustRedesign: Do not use sharp, high-contrast digital fonts
Ensure the egg does not look like a 3D render

mustAchieve: Naturalistic twig detail in the nest

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic twig shadows within the nest
Verify the egg has a matte, natural finish
Ensure typography is aligned to the top margin
Confirm the question mark looks printed on the egg, not floating
recipe.reuseFormula: Central organic subject + textured neutral background + top-aligned bold rounded sans-serif typography = 1970s conceptual soul aesthetic.
